propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider path; clients currently require an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy that sacrifices prompt caching and structured output

Bedrock model ids exhibit silent caching failures (zero read/write counters while billing full input) on certain models and require per-model measurement and warning logic to avoid undetected cost leaks
Temperature parameter is rejected (400 ValidationException) by some Bedrock models but not others, causing hard failures in Pass-2 verify steps that deliberately send temperature=0 for determinism

Prompt caching works on inference-profile ARNs (e.g. us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) but on-demand model ids are not invokable in measured environments, requiring the documented default to be an inference profile

The capability layer's profile-shaped override predicates cannot distinguish individual model ids within a provider, requiring a separate exact-id override table to handle per-model API defects without affecting the main model class

A sampling-parameter rejection (400 + parameter name + rejection word in error text) must translate to an LLMConfigError naming both the model id and remedies, distinguishing it from unrelated 400s that remain LLMUnavailableError
